relationships.subject: RvD2
relationships.evidence_quote: RvD1 and in particular RvD2 is able to directly inhibit TRP vanilloid subtypes 1, 3, 4 (TRPV1, TRPV3, and TRPV4) and ankyrin 1 (TRPA1) channels

relationships.subject: Lipoxin A4
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal administration of LXA4 or AT-15-epi-LXA4 results in lower production of tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-α in carrageenan-induced spinal pain and in spinal astrocyte cultures

relationships.subject: 17(R)-HDHA
relationships.evidence_quote: 17 (R)-HDHA was shown to blunt astrogliosis in the spinal cord (Huang et al., 2017), and to down-regulate NF-kB and COX2 in the dorsal horn of lumbar spinal cord and in DRG neurons

relationships.subject: RvD1
relationships.evidence_quote: RvD1 drives peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-γ (PPARγ)-dependent analgesic effects in db/db mice

key_findings: SPMs (resolvins, lipoxins, maresins) relieve neuropathic pain by controlling immune cells, inhibiting TRP channels (TRPV1, TRPA1) and interacting with opioid signalling.
Review notes SPM link to oxidative stress and Nrf2 is largely speculative.
